tex_content.html:
Proposition
[The Density Is the Absolute Value of the Volume Form]

↗ def:density-pointwise ↗ prop:volume-form-determinant

If $n>0$ and $\omega $ is the volume form of an oriented inner product space, then \[ |v_1\wedge \cdots \wedge v_n|=|\omega (v_1,\ldots ,v_n)|. \]

Proof

↗ prop:density-abs-det \sketch Choose an oriented orthonormal basis. The volume determinant formula and Proposition 9 express the two sides as the absolute value of the same determinant.

□
